events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Known for his distinctive voice and outspoken personality, Liam Gallagher, former frontman of Oasis and Beady Eye, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Legacy
angles.copy: Whether it's the anthems with Oasis or his solo work, Liam Gallagher always brings the attitude. Happy 54th to the iconic frontman!

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' (single) released
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK in 1975, four years after the album of the same name.

angles.name: Imagine Impact
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since the album, and this week marks the UK single release anniversary of John Lennon's 'Imagine'. A timeless message that still resonates today.

events.title: Apple unveiled the first iPod
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first time you saw an iPod? Twenty-five years ago this month, Apple unveiled the device that changed how we carry our music forever.

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the 1962 premiere of 'Dr. No', the first James Bond film.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Grab a martini (shaken, not stirred) – it's Global James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007 on the big screen. Which Bond is your favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary musician, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Ministry of Silly Walks
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, a true titan of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but commonly known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, self-titled double album – affectionately known as the 'White Album'. A true masterpiece of diverse sounds.

events.title: Anniversary of Freddie Mercury's death
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the legendary Queen frontman, passed away on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45 due to AIDS-related complications.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Today marks 35 years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to rock the world.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', on December 3, 1965, marking a pivotal moment in their artistic evolution.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-nine years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. An album that pushed boundaries and set the stage for their incredible creative journey.

events.title: Anniversary of John Lennon's death
events.blurb: On December 8, 1980, the world lost John Lennon, who was tragically shot at the age of 40 outside his New York City residence.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost a true visionary. Remembering John Lennon and his profound impact on music and the world.
